sql: SELECT TOP 10 um.Id AS userId, MIN(ps.ParentZnodeProductId) AS productId, MIN(ps.ParentName) AS productName FROM cso.TblCustom_UserManagement um INNER JOIN dbo.AspNetZnodeUser azu ON azu.UserName = um.UserName INNER JOIN dbo.AspNetUsers au ON au.UserName = azu.AspNetZnodeUserId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeUser zu ON zu.AspNetUserId = au.Id INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeUserPortal up ON up.UserId = zu.UserId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal po ON po.PortalId = up.PortalId AND po.StoreCode = um.StoreCode INNER JOIN cso.TblCustom_Allocations a ON a.SalesRepEmail = um.UserName INNER JOIN cso.ProductSearch ps ON ps.SKU = a.ChildSKU INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalCatalog pc ON pc.PublishCatalogId = ps.ZnodeCatalogId AND pc.PortalId = po.PortalId WHERE po.StoreCode = @store AND um.Role = @role AND zu.IsActive = @isActive AND au.LockoutEnd IS NULL AND a.Status = @allocationStatus AND a.QuantityRemaining > @zero AND ps.IsActive = @isActive AND ps.ParentZnodeProductId IS NOT NULL AND (@preferred IS NULL OR um.Id = @preferred) GROUP BY um.Id ORDER BY um.Id
